title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, billing statements and documented control paths are supported. It distinguishes existing Copilot and agent memory controls from the planned Work IQ memory path, whose default, specific permissions and governance details remain undocumented.

claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.
